cohort: Singleton neonates born between 24 0/7 and 33 6/7 weeks of gestation and admitted to tertiary neonatal units in Canada between 2010 and 2014, categorized as small-for-gestational-age (SGA) or appropriate-for-gestational-age (AGA).
finding: Exposure to antenatal corticosteroids 1-7 days before birth was associated with decreased odds of neonatal mortality and morbidity, with similar beneficial effects observed in both SGA and AGA preterm neonates.
birth_weight: Defined as less than the 10th percentile for SGA and between the 10th and 90th percentile for AGA.
